findings.title: BUY_HOLD reference violates its documented hold-to-end law
findings.documented_law: engine.py docstring: BUY_HOLD 'exits only via fold force-flat (hold-to-end modulo fold law)'
findings.observed: BUY_HOLD positions are opened as strategy=TREND_LONG, so the TREND_LONG exit signal (close<EMA20) closes mid-fold with reason strategy_exit and the intrabar stop is live; re-entry only at fold starts, so the reference sits flat after any mid-fold exit
findings.minimal_repro: one 20-bar fold, targets BUY_HOLD; bar 2 close 98 < EMA20 99.809519 -> exit at open[3] @98 reason strategy_exit (entry bar 1 @100, net -2118.8); invested==0 through fold end
findings.impact: buy-hold REFERENCE metric per cell is a trend-exit-managed path, not buy-and-hold; understates hold-to-end in down-drifts, adds churn; no scored arm affected; no dispatch law violated (module-documented law)

findings.title: stop level falls back to atr14[i] (entry bar's own TR) when atr14[i-1] is NaN (only i==13)
findings.impact: intra-bar lookahead in the stop LEVEL on the first ATR bar; stops still evaluated only on later bars; unreachable with warmup=192
